hover.reason: touch UI: Android has no hover or keyboard-focus variant in the emulator captures; use the pressed state (active) instead

focus.reason: touch UI: Android has no hover or keyboard-focus variant in the emulator captures; use the pressed state (active) instead

active.reason: pressed variants live on the components (see composedOf)

loading.description: this screen is the loading / busy state (composer spinner or stop button)

sheet-open.description: this screen shows permission-dialog open; the closed pose is the permission-dialog component state "closed" (translate off-screen)
